entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Diablo 3D item modeling reference, candidate concept turnaround, not a final game icon.
Subject: ONE Short Sword, catalog ID item.design.base.short-sword, original inventory cursor 64.
Input image 1 is the original pixel-art inventory silhouette and material/color reference. Reconstruct its exact readable silhouette: short straight double-edged steel blade, tapered spear point, clearly defined central bevel, modest straight silver crossguard, cylindrical reddish brown leather grip, simple stacked steel disc pommel. Keep original proportions, especially blade to handle. Do not add a large ornate golden guard, gems, spikes or a fantasy broad blade.
Create a professional high-detail 3D concept turnaround board with the exact SAME sword in four isolated views: large FRONT flat view, SIDE thickness view, BACK flat view, and perspective THREE-QUARTER view. Include one small inventory-composition thumbnail of that same sword oriented blade-up. All views must agree on geometry, grip and materials; no divergent variants.
Dark medieval Diablo 1 aesthetic, restrained realistic wrought steel with fine wear and slightly tarnished silver, tight dark red-brown leather wrapping. Subtle edge wear only, high-quality game prop, no excessive corrosion. Neutral soft studio light, enough brightness to read geometry; no colored light, baked dramatic shadows, scenery or hands. Plain charcoal gray background. Labels only SHORT SWORD / FRONT / SIDE / BACK / 3/4 / ICON. Clean spaced technical art board, whole blade and pommel always visible. Designed for later 3D generation and matching inventory/equipped views.
revisionPrompts: Edit only the small ICON inset at the right of this Short Sword concept board. Replace its pixel-art sword with a NEW high-detail realistic HD render of the exact same steel short sword already shown in the four main views: silver straight crossguard, reddish brown leather grip, stacked silver disc pommel, short pointed straight blade with central bevel. The inset sword must be crisp detailed 3D, no pixel-art or source sprite. Keep all four main views, all labels, overall layout, backdrop, geometry, colors and lighting exactly unchanged. This is a candidate modeling board, not a finished runtime icon.
entries.notes: Candidate concept only. Rear surfaces and thickness are inferred; modeling must reconcile view consistency. Inset is a new concept preview, not the final runtime icon.
